description: This file provides test utilities for ensuring JSON schemas for tools have not changed unexpectedly, including functions for snapshot comparison and updating.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Checks that the JSON schema for a tool has not changed unexpectedly by comparing it to a stored snapshot, with options to update or create snapshots.

methods.name: writeSnap
methods.description: Creates the snapshot directory if needed and writes the JSON contents to the snapshot file.
